description: Dedupe field sets and windows per operation type (03-api.md section 9, 04-crypto.md section 4.10, ADR-012). Normalisation: repo lowercased, SHAs lowercased, branch/head/base without a leading refs/heads/, text that is not printable ASCII replaced by sha256:<hex of its UTF-8>. Equal to agent_hub.crypto.dedupe and contracts/vectors/dedupe.json. Types without an entry have duplicate protection only through an idempotency key. An idempotency key never replaces the fields of a type that has an entry (KOR-28): the same content is a duplicate with any key, and the runner rejects a key reused for other content of the same task and such a type while the earlier operation holds its slot (params_invalid at /idempotency_key). For a type without an entry the key's slot makes any repetition with the key a duplicate. A duplicate is a slot held by an operation in accepted, executing or succeeded within window_seconds; failed, rejected and expired operations release the slot.

fields.name: task
fields.source: task ID of the requesting session

idempotency_key.window_rule: only for a type without dedupe fields: 86400

fields.name: ref
fields.source: commit SHA the ref resolved to, lowercased

fields.name: parent_sha
fields.source: parent commit determined at check time

fields.name: tree_sha
fields.source: tree SHA computed locally from the snapshot

fields.name: body
fields.source: sha256_hex(UTF-8 params.body, empty text when left out)
